snippet.title: Gunship Origins Announcement
snippet.description:
Take the pilot seat in Gunship: Origins, a new combat helicopter experience published by MicroProse.

Fly iconic helicopters including the AH-64 Apache, OH-58 Kiowa Warrior, and UH-60 Blackhawk across dynamic battlefields. Plan your routes, coordinate with your flight, and strike enemy forces in missions that change every time you play.

Go solo or team up in co-op with up to 8 players, take on a wide range of objectives, and rise through the ranks as you build your career.

🚁 Dynamic missions
👥 Up to 8-player co-op
🎖 Career progression
🌍 Real-world terrain

👉 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4055780/Gunship_Origins
